one-voice-fellowship-pca-falls-church-va.assessment: One Voice Fellowship is a Potomac Presbytery (PCA) church plant launched by Chris Sicks after his 20-year tenure as Pastor of Mercy at Alexandria Presbyterian Church. The congregation gathers in Falls Church, VA and provides live multi-language translation in 13 languages every Sunday — a refugee/immigrant-oriented ministry vision. PCA polity guarantees male eldership, Westminster confessional soteriology, and presbytery oversight. Sicks signed the 2020 Warhurst Protest, which expressed disagreement with PCA Standing Judicial Commission discipline around the Revoice / Greg Johnson SSA-pastor controversy. Men in Northern Virginia seeking a multi-ethnic PCA congregation should attend, then verify pastoral counseling posture and preaching content directly given the cultural-drift signal.
